title: Kruskal-Wallis test with group medians
summary: The rank-based comparison of three or more groups, reported beside each group's median.

sizing._why: No rank-test form is in the catalog; sizing needs an assumed distribution shape and is a simulation.

pinned_defaults: R: factor(arm) in the formula, so the grouping is explicit.
Python: groups split by arm label and passed to scipy.stats.kruskal. Both apply the tie correction and the chi-square approximation.
_no_effect_size: The test gives no effect size. The group medians are reported with it, and pairwise differences come from mann-whitney-hodges-lehmann with a multiplicity adjustment. The test reads as a comparison of medians only when the groups share one shape.
